coverage_note: Only workshop and dealer videos of the Speedster SR+ were found; no long-term owner review of the SR or SR+ has been identified yet. The dealer opinion is shown but not counted.

opinions.title: This Isn’t Your Typical Chinese Carbon Bike | Incolor SR+ Build
opinions.configuration: Customer's 58 cm SR+ built with 2× Dura-Ace Di2 at a UK workshop.
opinions.summary: The builders praised the finish, tidy routing, stiff bar and light weight, but found the bar heavy, the supplied bottles impractical and the tire room far short of the 38 mm headline on their 2× build.

opinions.title: Incolor Intropy SR+
opinions.configuration: Size-54 SR+ frameset held as shop stock by a French Incolor dealer.
opinions.summary: The dealer rates the routing through the compression ring, the 3D-printed titanium parts and the overall finish among the best he has seen; he had not built or ridden the frame.
